# Alpha Ahead LLC

> Alpha Ahead LLC is a US-based outsourcing and digital agency (St. Petersburg, Florida; Dubai, UAE; Islamabad, Pakistan) that provides dedicated virtual assistants, real estate cold callers, transaction coordinators, virtual property management, lead generation, SEO, web development, digital marketing, graphic design, video editing and IT support to businesses in the US and UAE. Teams work US (EST/PST) and UAE business hours.

Contact: info@alphaaheadllc.com · +1 424-542-7170 (US) · +971 4 432 3080 (Dubai) · https://alphaaheadllc.com/contact

## Services
- [Virtual Assistant Services](https://alphaaheadllc.com/virtual-assistant): Dedicated remote assistants for admin, inbox, calendar, CRM and real estate support.
- [Real Estate Cold Calling Services](https://alphaaheadllc.com/cold-calling): Callers for agents, investors and wholesalers; prospecting, qualification and appointment setting.
- [Remote Transaction Coordinator](https://alphaaheadllc.com/transaction-coordinator): Contract-to-close coordination for realtors.
- [Virtual Property Management Assistant](https://alphaaheadllc.com/property-management): Tenant communication, maintenance coordination, leasing and reporting support.
- [Lead Generation](https://alphaaheadllc.com/lead-generation): Real estate and B2B lead lists, outreach and qualification.
- [Personal Assistant](https://alphaaheadllc.com/personal-assistant): Remote personal assistants for executives.
- [Virtual Business Assistant](https://alphaaheadllc.com/business-assistant): Back-office, bookkeeping support and operations.
- [SEO Services](https://alphaaheadllc.com/seo): Technical, on-page and local SEO.
- [Web Development](https://alphaaheadllc.com/web-development): Fast, SEO-ready websites and web apps.
- [Digital Marketing](https://alphaaheadllc.com/digital-marketing): Paid ads, social media and email marketing.
- [Graphic Design](https://alphaaheadllc.com/graphic-design): Branding, social creatives and real estate marketing design.
- [Video Editing](https://alphaaheadllc.com/video-editing): Reels, YouTube, ads and listing videos.
- [IT Support](https://alphaaheadllc.com/it-support): Remote help desk, Microsoft 365/Google Workspace and cloud support.

## Guides, case studies and locations
- [How Much Does a Transaction Coordinator Cost? Per-File vs Monthly vs Offshore](https://alphaaheadllc.com/blog/transaction-coordinator-cost): Per-file, monthly retainer, in-house or offshore: how transaction coordinator pricing models compare, who usually pays the fee, and how to pick the right one for your deal volume.
- [In-House vs Outsourced Transaction Coordinator: Which Is Right for Your Business?](https://alphaaheadllc.com/blog/in-house-vs-outsourced-transaction-coordinator): A practical decision framework for agents and brokerages weighing an in-house transaction coordinator against an outsourced or remote one, with a simple checklist.
- [20 Tasks to Delegate to a Property Management Virtual Assistant](https://alphaaheadllc.com/blog/property-management-virtual-assistant-tasks): A practical list of 20 property management virtual assistant tasks, grouped by leasing, tenant communication, maintenance, accounting, owner reporting and marketing, plus how to onboard with SOPs.
- [Is Real Estate Cold Calling Legal? A Compliance Checklist for Outsourced Callers](https://alphaaheadllc.com/blog/is-real-estate-cold-calling-legal): Real estate cold calling is legal in the US when you scrub DNC lists, respect calling hours, follow TCPA rules and honor opt-outs. Here is a practical checklist for teams that outsource their calling.
- [Real Estate Cold Calling Cost: In-House vs VA vs Agency](https://alphaaheadllc.com/blog/real-estate-cold-calling-cost): The true cost of real estate cold calling is more than an hourly rate. Compare in-house callers, freelance VAs and managed agencies, the hidden costs of each, and how to measure ROI.
- [Pakistan vs Philippines Virtual Assistant: An Honest Comparison](https://alphaaheadllc.com/blog/pakistan-vs-philippines-virtual-assistant): Both Pakistan and the Philippines are strong places to hire a virtual assistant. Here is a balanced look at time zones, communication, skills, cost factors and reliability so you can choose well.
- [Zingo Assist: A Virtual Assistant Company Case Study](https://alphaaheadllc.com/case-studies/zingo-assist): How we built Zingo Assist, a dedicated virtual assistant brand with trained remote teams for real estate, finance and customer support.
- [Alpha Medi Assist: A Medical Billing Outsourcing Case Study](https://alphaaheadllc.com/case-studies/alpha-medi-assist): How we built Alpha Medi Assist, a healthcare operations brand that helps providers with medical billing, data management and administrative workflows.
- [Learn with Alpha: An E-Learning Platform Development Case Study](https://alphaaheadllc.com/case-studies/learn-with-alpha): How we built Learn with Alpha, an e-learning platform with flexible, personalized learning paths for students and working professionals.
- [Real Estate Virtual Assistant Dubai: Admin Support for Brokers and Agents](https://alphaaheadllc.com/real-estate-virtual-assistant-dubai): Remote admin support for Dubai brokers and agents: listing uploads, WhatsApp follow-up, CRM hygiene and viewing coordination on Dubai hours.
- [Virtual Assistant Services Dubai: Remote Staffing for UAE SMEs and Startups](https://alphaaheadllc.com/virtual-assistant-dubai): Remote staffing for UAE free zone and mainland companies: admin, customer support, bookkeeping support, social media and IT help, with a Dubai office.
- [Virtual Assistant St. Petersburg FL & Tampa: Real Estate and Small Business Support](https://alphaaheadllc.com/virtual-assistant-tampa-st-petersburg): Eastern Time virtual assistants for Tampa Bay realtors, investors, property managers and small businesses, from a company based in St. Petersburg.
